stories.title: Meghan's father Thomas Markle back in federal custody after allegedly removing ankle monitor
stories.body: The 82-year-old was placed under house detention in Florida last week after being charged over possession of child sex abuse material.

stories.title: Malaysia's disgraced former PM leaves jail for house arrest after embezzling millions
stories.body: Najib Razak was convicted for his role in the billion-dollar scandal involving the 1MDB sovereign wealth fund.

stories.title: Israel's new parliament sworn in as leaders compete to form government
stories.body: Benjamin Netanyahu's main political rival, Gadi Eisenkot, has first chance to build a new government and oust the prime minister.

stories.title: 'It can kill us': Kenyans fear impact of El Niño with floods predicted
stories.body: Forecasters warn that this year's El Niño could be one of the strongest on record, with heavy rain and flooding in Kenya.

stories.title: Violence erupts in Bangladesh as ousted PM's supporters stage protest
stories.body: Supporters of Sheikh Hasina want her to return from exile in India.

stories.title: Anti-homosexuality laws in Trinidad and Tobago overturned
stories.body: The ruling brings to an end an 11-year legal battle by dual-citizen Jason Jones.

stories.title: Spain's king and queen attend memorial service for rail crash victims
stories.body: Sixty-nine people died in the collision near Toledo two weeks ago and 28 are still in hospital.

stories.title: Board of Peace says Israel's aid response after Gaza floods 'insufficent'
stories.body: The group, formed by Trump, issues rare criticism of Israel, while also blaming Hamas for the suffering of civilians in Gaza.

stories.title: First day of Ukraine peace talks constructive, Zelensky says
stories.body: Delegations from Kyiv, Washington and Moscow are in the United Arab Emirates for the first trilateral talks since February.

stories.title: Nvidia hires major US law firm to investigate alleged Chinese spy affair
stories.body: The appointment was made after it emerged Jensen Huang had an affair with a woman believed to be a spy for China.

stories.title: French wartime resistance heroine Solange Alexandre dies aged 104
stories.body: With 30 men under her orders, she organised sabotage operations, sheltered Allied airmen and joined the fight against the occupying German forces.

stories.title: Makers of GLP-1 drugs ordered to add warnings about rare eye condition that can lead to blindness
stories.body: The US Food and Drug Administration says Ozempic, Wegovy, and other weight-loss drugs must have labels about the condition, known as NAION.

stories.title: Arrests made after visit from former US President Biden
stories.body: Joe Biden was in Dublin to see his son Hunter awarded the Gold Medal for Outstanding Contribution for Public Discourse

stories.title: Twelve dead after motorway pile-ups in Bulgaria fog
stories.body: About 50 other people were injured in the pile-ups along a section of the Trakia motorway, officials have said.

stories.title: US federal authorities could have prevented Epstein crimes, report finds
stories.body: The report by a Republican-led congressional committee follows a 15-month investigation into the handling of the late disgraced financier's case.

stories.title: Arrests made in Mohamed Al Fayed probe in France, police say
stories.body: The Ritz hotel in Paris, which is still owned by the Al Fayed family, is one of the properties searched by police.

stories.title: Police officer dies and another injured after backpack explosion in northern Spain
stories.body: Officers attended the scene in connection with a separate incident at a residential building in the Spanish city.

stories.title: DR Congo sentences 66 soldiers to death for being 'cowards'
stories.body: The Congolese army's fight against rebel groups has long been hampered by disarray within its ranks.

stories.title: 'Cruise for life' ship seized in Singapore
stories.body: The Odyssey was meant to take guests around the world for years, but the trip was cut short after its operator ran out of money.

stories.title: Trump says FBI investigating Nvidia boss's affair with alleged Chinese spy
stories.body: The US president said he spoke with Jensen Huang on Monday and asked him about the affair with the alleged spy.
